notes: Cloudflare Worker run from source with `wrangler dev` (Miniflare). Local D1 lives in .wrangler/state inside the repository bind mount; there is no database service. Operational routes stay closed (HTTP 503) until NYX_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD is set.

secrets.name: NYX_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Panel sign-in password, 16-256 characters. It seeds the admin account and the panel password hash on the first operational request, so the value entered here is the one used to sign in at /panel. No value is generated for it on purpose: a generated placeholder could never be typed at the login form, and once the hash is stored a different secret no longer changes the password (wipe .wrangler/state to re-bootstrap).
